items.title: RBA governor grilled over rising inflation as political fight heats up
items.description: RBA governor Michele Bullock has refused to blame the Albanese government for rising inflation, as a political fight breaks out in the wake of the bank's rate hike.

items.title: Bushfire downgrade for blaze impacting Perth hills residents
items.description: Fire authorities downgrade a bushfire in Darlington and Helena Valley as it becomes stationary but not controlled.

items.title: Writers festival 'crazy' to invite Randa Abdel-Fattah, NSW premier says
items.description: The festival's director said Dr Abdel-Fattah was invited in August last year and denied the state government pressured her to remove the writer.

items.title: I have a question for the men who had no questions about Epstein
items.description: The millions of pages of documents related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein have shone a light on how many influential men were ready to disregard the experiences of countless women.

items.title: Light plane crashes into ocean on South Australia's south coast
items.description: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau says it has begun an investigation into a crash involving a single-engine Cessna aeroplane which has "collided with water".

items.title: AACTA key moments: Gory horror wins best film, Jacob Elordi drama dominates TV
items.description: Directors Danny and Michael Philippou clean up at the 2026 AACTA awards, taking home 10 statues for their chilling horror film Bring Her Back.

items.title: Why the Invasion Day attempted bombing response differed to that of Bondi
items.description: When a homemade fragment bomb was allegedly thrown into a crowd on January 26, it took nine days for it to be declared an act of terrorism. The WA police commissioner explains why, as Indigenous leaders raise concerns.

items.title: At least 31 killed, 169 wounded in Islamabad suicide bombing
items.description: The explosion rocked the mosque on the outskirts of Pakistan's capital during Friday prayer.

items.title: Russian general shot 'several times' in Moscow
items.description: Lieutenant General Vladimir Alexeyev, a senior Russian military official, has been rushed to hospital after being shot in Moscow.

items.title: Woman's death after repeated sedation 'entirely preventable', inquest hears
items.description: A coronial inquest has heard that the death of a 34-year-old mother who was repeatedly sedated during a schizophrenic episode was "entirely preventable".

items.title: Patrol boats out of action as illegal foreign fishers reach Australian shores
items.description: A "continuous" influx of illegal foreign fishing boats in Queensland waters coincides with at least two of the nation's fleet of patrol boats being out of commission.

items.title: Gus Lamont's grandparents 'absolutely devastated' by major crime declaration
items.description: The grandparents of missing four-year-old boy Gus Lamont say the family has "cooperated fully with the investigation and want nothing more than to find Gus and reunite him with his mum and dad".

items.title: Trump's would-be assassin had one goal: 'up-end American democracy'
items.description: As Donald Trump arrived at a golf course in September 2024, a would-be assassin had already been lying in wait for almost 12 hours.

items.title: US senators reportedly want SpaceX probed for potential Chinese ownership
items.description: Chinese investment in Elon Musk's company SpaceX has been cited as a "national security threat", according to senators Elizabeth Warren and Andy Kim.

items.title: Accused murderer told police he wanted to kill 'a few people', court hears
items.description: A recorded police interview reveals that a man accused of killing a woman at a real estate business in Adelaide was not satisfied with his alleged murder.

items.title: Japan's cherry blossom festival cancelled due to fear of overtourism
items.description: The blossom festival, which brings about 200,000 people each year, has been cancelled because "the quiet lives of local residents are threatened".

items.title: Nagi is normalising taking time for our pets — here's why that's important
items.description: Experts say our pets have become such an important part of our lives that it's important to take a step back from responsibilities, if possible, when they are sick or dying.

items.title: 'Every single person is on guard': Minneapolis's week of chaos after killing of Renee Good
items.description: Renee Good and her wife moved to Minneapolis "to make a better life" with their six-year-old son. But just over two minutes into an encounter with ICE agents she was fatally shot.

items.title: Underworld figure Tony Mokbel a free man after drug case abandoned
items.description: Prosecutors have abandoned a drug trafficking case against underworld figure Tony Mokbel following his release from prison last year.

items.title: France says Australia-bound drug ship isn't its problem after setting crew free
items.description: French authorities intercept a ship carrying five tonnes of cocaine bound for Australia, before releasing the vessel and its crew.

items.title: Author Craig Silvey has bail conditions changed after 'media attention'
items.description: WA children's author Craig Silvey gets his bail conditions altered by a Perth court after complaining of "significant media attention" since being charged with child exploitation offences.

items.title: Hazlewood out of T20 World Cup in further blow to Australia's hopes
items.description: Josh Hazlewood is ruled out of Australia's T20 World Cup campaign as he continues to recover from the injuries which kept him from playing in the summer's Ashes series.

items.title: Think the Winter Olympics are indecipherable? Here's everything you need to know
items.description: Australia is tipped for enormous success over the next couple of weeks so now might be a good time to clue yourself up. Here's everything you need to know about the 2026 Winter Games.

items.title: 'The women just want to play footy': Premier backs shunned country club
items.description: A former football administrator has criticised AFL Victoria's decision not to allow a club to join a women-only league in Central Victoria.

items.title: Australia and Indonesia sign major security pact
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has travelled to Jakarta to sign the treaty, which the Australian government calls the "biggest step" the countries have taken together in 30 years.
